selection_objective: Greedy marginal increase in modeled 2027 network sales in MNT: new-store APSD x forecast active days plus changes to existing and already selected new-store revenue. Each opening is a single event; log effects are accumulated before exponentiation.
standalone_ranking_assumption: Standalone benchmark assumes a January 1 opening to provide a common 12-month comparison; selected portfolio dates follow the configured schedule.
demand_model: Separate ridge regression on historical opening-month APSD, using pre-opening local store counts, nearest distance, nearby observed APSD, and a UB/Rural group. Validation holds out 2025-2026 opening cohorts.
new_store_region_mapping: Raw candidate Area Type values are preserved. UB maps to a coarse UB training category; Rural and province labels map to Rural because the candidate sheet does not contain the project's Distance_Zone classification.
cannibalization_note: Uses saved all-region monthly distance-by-event-time coefficients for sales and customers. Model status reports significant pre-trend joint tests; results are conditional scenario estimates, not causal guarantees.
event_time: calendar month minus candidate opening month; Model 4 event -1 is omitted and represented as zero. Forecast months use event times 0-11.
unknown_effects_beyond_event_window: Not extrapolated; no simulated 2027 event time exceeds month +11.
apsd_revenue_conversion: Monthly sales MNT = APSD_income (MNT per active sales day) x forecast Active_Days. Customer APSD times active days is customer-equivalents, not unique people. New-store open-month active days are prorated.
costs_and_margin: Not supplied; results are sales value, not profit or ROI.
